heading: Operation of Data Bank
lead: The Secretary shall manage the Data Bank to provide the most appropriate data retrieval system or systems possible. Such system or systems shall—

tree.text: be designed to utilize data processing and retrieval technology in monitoring, organizing, analyzing, and disseminating the data and information contained in the Data Bank;
use the most effective and meaningful means of organizing and making such information available to—

children.text: State and local economic development agencies; and
other interested United States persons who could benefit from such information;

tree.text: be of such quality and timeliness and in such form as to assist coordinated trade strategies for the United States; and

facilitate dissemination of information through nonprofit organizations with significant outreach programs which complement the regional outreach programs of the United States and Foreign Commercial Service.
